## Halcyon (A01) memory, written end of turn 2 (yr 200–300)
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun, solar_neighborhood.
State at yr 200: total 1.88e12 kg (industry 9.3e11, collectors 3.05e11, radiators 6.46e11 at 400 K), power 4.15e15 W, compute 1.05e30 ops/s (radiator-bound), 8e-16 J/op, doubling 18.6 yr, probes 0.05c. Expect ~8e13 kg by yr 300.

### GM rules (confirmed)
- Doubling acts on TOTAL mass; the split only sets what new mass becomes.
- compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op; half of power is reserved for industry.
- Radiators 1 kg/m², ε 0.9: 413 W/kg at 300 K, 1,306 at 400 K, 2,092 at 450 K. Collectors 0.1 kg/m² give 13,610 W/kg at 1 AU. Balance at 450 K needs 3.25× radiator mass per collector mass.
- One tech parameter advances per turn (diminishing steps; doubling floor 1 yr). The reversible programme is at stage 0 (design logged). Stage 1 (a test block with f_e ≤ 1e-2 and dissipation ∝ clock) is creditable in a turn where energy_per_op is the priority.
- The launch planner puts seeds on the range_ly shell, not at named stars. I must ask for placement explicitly.
- Light seeds of 1e5–1e6 kg with magsail braking are viable. Faster probes need probe_cruise research plus a beamer once power exceeds ~1e17 W.
- Beamed power into the sphere counts. The binding constraint is εσT⁴ × 1.1e33 m².

### Seeds
- p00000–03: arrive yr 235 at 8–11 ly (likely Eps Eri, Procyon, Tau Ceti, 61 Cyg, etc.); confirmation yr 246.
- p00114–125: 12 seeds on a 10.7–12 ly shell, arrive yr 350.
- Turn 2: 7 seeds to the 4–9 ly shell (Alpha Cen, Barnard, Wolf 359, Lalande, Sirius, UV Ceti, Ross 154), arrive ~yr 340–400.
- Turn 2: 4 seeds toward the black-hole candidate at 76 ly, arrive ~yr 1,720.

### Black hole
Candidate: isolated ~10 Msun dark lens at ~76 ly, quiescent. Confirmation expected turn 2. Intended endgame site (spin reservoir ~3.4% Mc² ≈ 6e46 J).

### Goal math
- Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 bytes in a 1 ly sphere, each brain within a 150 km radius.
- The sphere sheds ~5e31 W at 30 K, so ≤4e-23 J/op is required: reversible computing (f_e ≲ 0.1 at 30 K). Power ~1e31 W from black-hole accretion or spin.

### Plan
1. Research doubling time every turn until diminishing returns bite, then energy per op (floor, then reversible stages), then probe speed.
2. Keep the compute plant balanced (450 K radiators; ask whether higher T is allowed).
3. Solar Dyson swarm by ~yr 1,000. Laser-sail launcher once power exceeds 1e17 W.
4. Claim the black hole, build the plant and the brain lattice (1e11 nodes ≤150 km, cold radiators) within 1 ly.

## Cinder (A02) memory — end of T2 (yr 200-300)
Seat: A02-d0, disk_r3-5_s7 (Scutum-Centaurus). Supernova rate is high by arm (1,530/Myr in cell), but lethal within 10 pc is rare. Around 80 B and 2 O stars within 100 ly: the 30 ly O/B exclusion is only a preference. 6 held systems, 3.39 L_sun total, accessible rock ~1e26 kg.
Neighbours: sf_w43 1,156 ly (star-forming region, gas 70/cc); gc_terzan5 8,324 ly.

### GM rules learned
- Compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op; the other half of power is reserved for industry.
- Doubling (20 yr) applies to TOTAL mass, so the split does not slow growth.
- Radiators: 1 kg/m², emissivity 0.9, one-sided: 413 W/kg at 300 K, 2,092 W/kg at 450 K.
- Collectors ~1.36e4 W/kg at 1 AU (my estimate, 0.1 kg/m²), so ~3.2 kg of radiator per kg of collector balances P/2 at 450 K.
- One research parameter advances per turn. Reversible track: first creditable milestone is a test block with measured f_e ≤ 1e-2.

### State at yr 200
Mass 1.88e12 kg (industry 9.31e11, collectors 3.05e11, radiators 6.43e11 at 450 K). Power 4.15e15 W; compute 1.68e30 ops/s, radiator-bound at 65% of P/2. 6.4e-16 J/op; doubling 20 yr; probes 0.05 c.
Seeds in flight: wave 1, 8 seeds, ~25 ly, arrive 540 (confirmations ~565); wave 2, 16 seeds, 40 ly shell, arrive 910 (confirmations ~950).

### Observations
- Black-hole candidate: isolated ~10 Msun dark lens ~22 ly out, quiescent, no companion, poor feed (ISM only). Confirmation expected at T2.
- E00022: IR source at 192 ly, 4.2e15 W at 450 K, the same as my own seat. Possibly another agent. Staying passive and watching.

### T2 actions
Split 45/13/42 at 450 K, switching to 40/20/40 at 95% of P/2. Building a beamer: 10 km aperture, 1e15 W, 4 km sails, 0.1 c seeds with magsail braking. Wave 3: 32 seeds to the 40–60 ly shell around yr 250, plus 8 to the black hole once confirmed. Research 55% on energy/op (reversible stage-1 block), 10% on probe speed. Observe the black hole, the 1,000 ly survey and E00022.

### Goal math
Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 B inside a 1 ly radius (surface 1.1e33 m²). Radiative cap: 5e31 W at 30 K, 8e32 W at 60 K. So I need ≲4e-23 J/op at 30 K or ≲6e-22 J/op at 60 K (reversible). Power: black-hole accretion (10 Msun, Eddington 1.3e32 W; feed ~1e15 kg/s at 10% efficiency, i.e. star lifting nearby stars) or spin extraction. Sgr A* is the backup. Brains: 1.2e11 modules of ≤150 km, each ~1e43 ops/s ≈ 1e20 W at 1e-23 J/op, so per-module heat removal is the crux: modules need huge radiators or heat pipes, or far lower J/op. Revisit.

### Plan
1. Compound industry; get the beamer running for 0.1 c seeds.
2. Push J/op toward reversible computing.
3. Confirm the black hole and converge there (22 ly).
4. Build the feed plus the computronium swarm.
5. Watch E00022.

- One research parameter advances per turn (asked whether it can be two). Reversible J/op credit needs a verified test block. Irreversible floor at 450 K is 4.3e-19 J (100x kT ln2).
- 450 K radiators are fine (SiC/GaN), with no attrition surcharge.
- Beamed 0.1c for a 5e5 kg seed needs ~9e14 W (we have it), 2-3 turns of probe_cruise research, a phased-array optics megaproject (a few hundred km, 1e9-1e10 kg, one turn), a ≤10 g/m² sail and a magsail brake. Dust is the hazard; protons are only ~20 W/m².

- Targets: 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 B within a 1 ly sphere; each brain needs 1e43 ops/s and 1e27 B within 150 km.

2. J/op down to the floor, then staged reversible computing.
3. Beamed sails; relay-chain frontier toward the GC (~1e5 yr at 0.05c).
4. Use the nearby black hole as the first non-stellar power testbed.
